messages.subject: ggplot2 themes
parts:
Hi,

I'm having trouble editing the qplot layout. I'm using the
geom="tile"
option and I want to do a few things:

1. move the vertical and horizontal gridlines so that they appear on
the
edge of each tile (right now they're in the middle)
2. bring the gridlines to the foreground and change their color

I've been playing around with the opts(...) options but so far can't
get any
of them to work correctly. Has anyone done this or have an example

thanks

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: ggplot2 themes
parts:
Hi evgeny,

In that case it's probably easiest to turn the grid lines off and then
recreate them yourself with geom_hline and geom_vline.

Hadley
